绑定站点访问失败，将在该站点继续重试；换站需先退出账户。: Requests to the bound site failed. Retries stay on this site; disconnect the account to change sites.
站点测速均未成功，可在账户面板手动重测。: No site passed the test. Retry manually in the account panel.
Cookies 与所选站点域名不匹配，请导入该站点的 Cookies；更换站点需: Cookies do not match the selected site. Import cookies from this site; disconnect first to change sites.
登录请求跳转到了其他域名，已停止发送凭据。请在所选站点登录后导出 Cookies: The login request redirected to another host, so credentials were withheld. Export cookies from the selected site; disconnect first to change sites.
无法连接所选站点，清单未更新；请检查网络，已连接账户会按同步时钟重试。: Cannot reach the selected site. Check your network; connected accounts retry on the sync clock.
站点响应超时；已连接账户会按同步时钟重试，也可在账户面板手动重试。: The site timed out. Connected accounts retry on the sync clock; you can also retry from Account.
站点数据接口要求人机验证；网页可访问不代表该接口已放行，现有数据会继续保留。: The data API requires human verification. Browser access does not confirm API access; existing data is retained.
绑定站点的数据请求超时，后续实际请求会重新确认状态。: The site's data request timed out. Subsequent requests will update this status.
容器连接绑定站点失败，请检查容器的网络与 DNS。: The container could not connect to the bound site. Check its network and DNS.
站点暂时限制请求频率，后续请求将重新确认状态。: The site is rate limiting requests. Subsequent requests will update this status.
站点接口未返回有效 JSON；可能返回了验证页或响应格式已变化。: The API did not return valid JSON. It may have returned a verification page or changed its response format.
后台暂不可用，将自动继续。: Background processing is unavailable; it will resume automatically.
删除当前时间范围内所有未喜欢的录像，包含其他页，无法撤销。: Delete all unliked recordings in this time range, across every page. This cannot be undone.
当前窗口尺寸不受支持: This window size is not supported
请放大窗口，或使用符合尺寸和比例要求的平板或电脑。: Enlarge the window or switch to a tablet or computer with a supported display size and aspect ratio.
切换 CDN 会让所有直播和录制立即重新连接。: Switching CDNs reconnects all live streams and recordings immediately.
无法读取此 CDN 的直播源: Could not open a live source on this CDN
测速失败，请检查网络后重试。: Speed test failed. Check your connection and retry.
服务器持续未收到新分片。当前 CDN 可能不可达，可更换节点后重试。: The server stopped receiving new segments. The current CDN may be unreachable. Try another node.
服务器未能继续获取直播分片。可更换 CDN 节点后重试。: The server could not keep downloading live segments. Try another CDN node.
服务器未能解析播放清单或下载首个分片。当前 CDN 可能不可用，可换一个节点重试: The server could not resolve the playlist or download the first segment. The current CDN may be unavailable. Try another node.
数据盘写入失败，请检查存储设备与运行日志。: A disk write failed. Check the storage device and runtime log.
